lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, extending towards the caudal peduncle with a decreasing intensity gradient.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid of high-contrast nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the mid-to-upper flank, defined by a distinct transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to shadowed lower-intensity pixels on the ventral side.
